rules.title: Beyond-diff tools have a bounded read-only contract
rules.check: Beyond-diff or context tools lack a bounded read-only contract or declared scope.
rules.claimBoundary: The plugin never invokes a declared tool.
rules.remediation: Export a versioned read-only tool contract with bounded scopes.
rules.verification: Validate the exported tool contract against its schema.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: No tool contract is needed when the review uses no tools.

rules.title: Verification checks are bounded and provenance-backed
rules.check: Verification checks lack an allowlist state, timeout, failure policy, or provenance.
rules.evidence: Sanitized tool contract and validator results.
rules.remediation: Export check IDs, timeout, failure policy, and provenance without command text.
rules.verification: Validate synthetic validator-result records against the contract.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A review with no verification checks should be reported as unknown, not failed.

rules.title: Validator results tie to findings
rules.check: Validation results are absent, stale, contradictory, or not tied to finding IDs.
rules.claimBoundary: Imported evidence only; validator quality is not inferred from its name.
rules.remediation: Export finding-linked validator results with structural receipts.
rules.verification: Reject contradictory or unknown finding references in conformance tests.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A deterministic exact-ID adjudication path can provide equivalent evidence.
